series_annotator.narrative: The series exhibits a consistent downward trend with moderate strength and detectable seasonality. High spectral entropy indicates unpredictable noise, while significant model performance spread and concept drift suggest robust baseline methods (e.g., median) are preferable to avoid overfitting to unstable model rankings.

reasoning.robust_median: series_profile.combination_recommendation.method_hint=robust_median → high noise/unpredictability (spectral_entropy=0.8359) demands robustness to outliers
reasoning.trimmed_mean_r0.10: series_profile.model_landscape.rankings_stable=false (kendall_tau=0.3684) → trimmed mean mitigates unstable rankings by discarding extreme values
reasoning.inverse_rmse_weights_k4_sh0.35: series_profile.model_landscape.rmse_spread_ratio=3.1168 AND rankings_stable=false → inverse RMSE weights with shrinkage (0.35) balances performance heterogeneity while avoiding overfitting

excluded_highlights.ridge_stacking_l250_topk3: series_profile.combination_recommendation.avoid=ridge_stacking → high noise/unpredictability makes ridge stacking prone to overfitting with n_windows=2
